title: What the Employer's Site Programmes Change for an Employee Meal Account
content:
What the employer holds at the site changes where an employee's allowance reaches and what the Employee Meal Account may do.

## The cafe counter

Where the employer holds an active Workplace Cafe Management Program contract at the account's site, allowance is spendable at the cafe counter, and the employer's own subsidy funding meets the drawdown behind it. **That last part is no longer in force**: what the employer's counter contributes now stands beside the employee's own lots rather than behind them, on the current basis for working out an application, and this document does not restate its quantities. Where that contract stands suspended, the counter is shut and no allowance is spent there.

## The micro market

Where the employer also holds an active Unattended Micro Market Program at the site and the plan's allowance scope reaches beyond the cafe, allowance is spendable at the kiosk as well, and the employee's daily ceiling is read across both outlets together rather than once at each.

Where the plan's allowance scope is limited to the cafe, a purchase at the kiosk draws no allowance however much is left, and the employee pays it from stored value or payroll.

## Catering

A meal account and an employer's catering agreement never interact: food ordered on a catering agreement is the employer's purchase, and an employee may not put a catering order on their meal account.

## When the cafe contract closes

Where the employer's cafe contract closes and no micro market stands at the site, the account keeps its stored value and its payroll terms, but no further allowance is granted, since there is no programme left to fund it.

## The same, as a table

| What the employer holds at the site | Where allowance reaches | How the daily ceiling is read |
|---|---|---|
| An active cafe contract only | The cafe counter | Once, at the cafe |
| An active cafe contract and an active micro market, the plan's scope reaching beyond the cafe | The cafe counter and the kiosk | Across both outlets together |
| An active cafe contract and an active micro market, the plan's scope limited to the cafe | The cafe counter only | Once, at the cafe |
| A suspended cafe contract | Nowhere; the counter is shut | Not read |
| No cafe contract and no micro market | No further allowance is granted | Not read |

superseded_clauses: the employer's own subsidy funding meets the drawdown behind it
